description: This file defines the ScopeRepository class implementing OAuth2 scope management, with methods for retrieving and finalizing scopes, though currently both methods return default values indicating no scope support.

classes.name: ScopeRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 ScopeRepositoryInterface with stub methods for scope handling in OAuth2 authentication.

methods.name: getScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a scope entity by its identifier; currently returns null, indicating no scope support.

methods.name: finalizeScopes
methods.description: Finalizes and returns the list of scopes for a given OAuth2 grant; currently returns an empty array, indicating no scopes are defined.
